prompts.text: Explain in detail the difference between a stack and a queue in data structures, including the time complexity of each operation (push, pop, enqueue, dequeue) and provide concrete examples of when you would use each one in a real-world application. Also discuss the space complexity of each data structure and how they are implemented in common programming languages such as Python and C++.

Write a Python function that takes a list of integers as input and returns the sum of all even numbers in the list. The function should handle edge cases such as an empty list, a list with no even numbers, and a list with negative numbers. Include docstrings and type hints in your answer.

Once upon a time, in a land far away, there lived a young dragon who dreamed of flying across the vast ocean to find his lost family. Every night, he would look up at the stars and wonder if his parents were still alive somewhere in the world. One day, he decided to embark on a journey to find them, no matter how dangerous the path might be.
